name: tilttek/dice-probability-bundle
description: tilttek/dice-probability in Symfony: the odds of a dice expression in Twig, as an accessible table and chart, updated live as it is typed.

suggest.ext-gmp: To write the long fractions of the probabilities in their lowest terms
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes the table, the chart and the component are drawn with, installed by the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: For the rate limit of <twig:TilttekDiceProbability:Distribution>, on by default: required with symfony/ux-live-component unless "rate_limit.enabled" is false
suggest.symfony/translation: To translate the words of the table, the chart and the component
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the Twig functions and the table and chart of the probabilities, with symfony/ux-twig-component
suggest.symfony/ux-live-component: For the probabilities on a page, <twig:TilttekDiceProbability:Distribution>, with symfony/ux-twig-component
